🇨🇦 When did software become temporary?

You buy a device. It works. Then the company shuts down a server, removes an app or ends support—and suddenly your perfectly good hardware becomes useless.

Nothing broke. Someone simply stopped supporting it.

Open source offers another possibility: software that can outlive the company or business model that created it.

If we own the hardware, we should have a reasonable opportunity to keep it working.

#OpenSource #RightToRepair #Linux
